# shadcn stylesheet snapshot

Source: shadcn npm package 4.23.0, dist/tailwind.css, MIT license. Upstream: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/tree/shadcn%404.23.0/packages/shadcn

The app imports only this CSS. It is copied byte-for-byte to avoid installing the unused CLI and registry dependency tree. Keep shadcn-LICENSE.md with this copy and include both files in source distributions. No CLI executable is provided; components remain local React/Base UI source. Review any future generator use separately rather than silently restoring the CLI dependency.

CSS SHA-256: 4c371f7a1ff5d219ae2f7ff28bd256b4346fd546fe46fbae22092e57db2f0fae
License SHA-256: 1564074e13439397221ffd522e2e504d56561994a23d371aa5e3ad43e4f5423f

These two upstream files are excluded from formatting. This snapshot is separate from the immutable Poster People agent kit. Any update requires reviewing generated CSS and the affected states.
